## Knowledge Card: AI & LLM Developments (Week of Feb 17–23, 2025)

### GPT-5 "Orion" Preview by OpenAI
- **What**: Limited public preview of **GPT-5 ("Orion")** started for select ChatGPT Plus users on mobile (Feb 18–20).
- **Features**:
  - Unified model replacing o-series and GPT-4.5.
  - Integrated reasoning + tool-use pipeline.
  - Early benchmarks show ~30–40% improvement on SWE-bench and fewer hallucinations in long-form outputs.
- **Rollout Plan**: Phased rollout; full release expected **March/April 2025**.
- **Source**: [The Information (Feb 19)](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/openai-begins-testing-gpt-5-orion-in-chatgpt-app), [TechCrunch (Feb 20)](https://techcrunch.com/2025/02/20/openai-starts-rolling-out-gpt-5-orion-to-select-chatgpt-users/)

---

### Gemini 2.5 Pro Flash from Google DeepMind
- **What**: Released **Gemini 2.5 Pro Flash**, a hybrid “thinking + fast” model (Feb 21).
- **Performance**:
  - Tops GPQA at **80.1%** accuracy.
  - 10x faster and 5x cheaper than full Gemini 2.5 Pro.
  - Supports **2M token context window**.
- **Availability**: Live on **Vertex AI** and **Gemini API**.
- **Use Case Fit**: Efficient for production inference where cost/speed matter.
- **Source**: [Google AI Blog (Feb 21)](https://blog.google/technology/ai/gemini-2-5-pro-flash/)

---

### Codestral 25.02 by Mistral AI
- **What**: Latest code-focused LLM released under **Apache 2.0 license** (Feb 18).
- **Features**:
  - **256K-token context window**.
  - Reduces copy-paste duplication in generated code by 40%.
  - Introduces **autonomous diffing** — patches apply directly without syntax errors.
- **Benchmarks**: Beats GPT-4o on HumanEval (**95.2%**).
- **Hosting Options**: Self-hostable or via **La Plateforme**.
- **Source**: [Mistral AI blog (Feb 18)](https://mistral.ai/news/codestral-2502)

---

### Llama 4 Leaked Models (Scout & Maverick)
- **What**: Internal models **Llama 4 Scout (300B)** and **Maverick (400B)** were leaked via Hugging Face repo (Feb 19), not yet officially confirmed.
- **Architecture Highlights**:
  - Uses **interleaved attention** mechanism.
  - Supports up to **10M-token effective context** via sliding window.
  - Scout reportedly beats DeepSeek-V3 by 2.1 pts on MMLU-Pro.
- **Expected Release**: Scheduled for **March 2025**.
- **Note**: Status unconfirmed; treat leaks as speculative until official announcement.
- **Sources**: [Hugging Face repo](https://huggingface.co/models?search=llama-4-scout), [Reuters (Feb 20)](https://www.reuters.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/meta-ai-leak-llama-4-weights/)

---

### LangChain v0.4 + Lingua Agent Framework
- **What**: Major upgrade released (Feb 17) introducing **Lingua**, a declarative YAML-based framework for multi-agent systems.
- **Key Changes**:
  - Auto fallback between tools/providers on failure.
  - Visual debugger in **LangGraph Studio** showing token-level reasoning.
  - Breaking change: deprecates older APIs.
- **Target Audience**: Developers building agent swarms or complex orchestration pipelines.
- **Source**: [LangChain changelog (Feb 17)](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/releases/tag/v0.4.0)

---

### vLLM 0.7.0 Performance Boost
- **What**: New inference server version with performance gains (Feb 19).
- **Improvements**:
  - PagedCache reduces GPU fragmentation by 45%.
  - Up to **3.1x throughput boost** on Llama-3-70B.
  - Native support for **FlashAttention-3** (Hopper GPUs only).
  - Quantization-aware speculative decoding (4-bit / 8-bit models).
- **Status**: Now recommended for production self-hosted deployments.
- **Source**: [vLLM GitHub release (Feb 19)](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/releases/tag/v0.7.0)

---

### Ollama Cloud & Local Fine-Tuning
- **What**: Ollama launched cloud hosting beta and added local LoRA fine-tuning (Feb 20).
- **Cloud Offering**: Run any model from the Ollama library via API, including custom-quantized versions.
- **Fine-Tuning Feature**:
  - CLI command: `ollama fine-tune`.
  - Train small models like Qwen2.5-7B on a single GPU (e.g., RTX 4090) in under two hours.
- **Relevance**: Great for desktop AI developers needing quick iteration loops.
- **Source**: [Ollama blog (Feb 20)](https://ollama.com/blog/cloud-and-finetune)

---

### SmolLM3 & Transformers 5.0 Alpha
- **What**: Hugging Face released **SmolLM3** and **Transformers v5.0 alpha** (Feb 20–21).
- **SmolLM3 Details**:
  - Efficient models at 0.5B, 1.7B, and 3B scales.
  - Outperforms Phi-3.5-mini and Qwen2.5-1.5B on reasoning benchmarks while being smaller.
- **Transformers v5.0 Features**:
  - Unified C++ tokenizer backend supporting 200+ tokenizers.
  - Faster generation (2x speed gain).
  - Removed legacy PyTorch 1.x compatibility.
- **Status**: v5.0 is alpha — breaking changes possible.
- **Sources**: [SmolLM3 card](https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B), [Transformers v5 alpha notes](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/releases/tag/v5.0.0-alpha.0)

---

### Agentic RAG 2.0 (Anthropic Research)
- **What**: Paper introducing **Contextual Memory Agents (CMA)** that combine RAG with persistent state tracking over time (Feb 18).
- **Benefits**:
  - Improves accuracy by **18.7%** over standard RAG on LongBench-Plus.
  - Cuts token overhead by 32% through smart caching of past interactions.
- **Availability**: Experimental feature now available in **Claude API**.
- **Implication**: Better memory management for chatbots and agent swarms.
- **Source**: [Anthropic research page (Feb 18)](https://www.anthropic.com/research/contextual-memory-agents)

---

### NVIDIA Nemotron-360M for Edge Devices
- **What**: Lightweight 0.36B-parameter model designed for edge inference (Feb 18).
- **Specs**:
  - Runs on **Raspberry Pi 5** at 12 tokens/sec.
  - Optimized for hybrid cloud-edge fallback scenarios.
  - 2-bit PTQ quantization used.
- **Benchmark**: Matches 96% of 7B performance on GSM8K-style tasks.
- **Ideal For**: Offline assistants, IoT apps, embedded systems.
- **Source**: [NVIDIA AI blog (Feb 18)](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/nemotron-edge-360m/)

---

### EU AI Act Enforcement Begins
- **What**: First binding provisions took effect Feb 20, 2025, banning:
  - Social scoring systems.
  - Manipulative deepfakes.
  - Real-time biometric ID in public spaces.
- **Compliance Requirements**:
  - Mandatory bias audits for use in HR, healthcare, finance sectors across EU.
- **Industry Response**: Several providers added **“EU mode”** endpoints with automated auditing.
- **Source**: [EU Commission AI Act timeline (Feb 20)](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/ai-act-timeline)

---

### Microsoft AI Shell CLI Tool
- **What**: New command-line tool integrating an LLM into PowerShell/Bash workflows (Feb 17).
- **Notable Features**:
  - Generate shell commands from natural language.
  - System introspection for auto-switching between GPU/CPU during inference.
  - Available for **Windows 11** and **WSL**.
- **Developer Benefit**: Automates tuning of local inference environments based on hardware load.
- **Source**: [Azure AI blog (Feb 17)](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/ai-shell-preview/)

---

## Weekly Summary
| Topic | Change | Impact |
|-------|--------|--------|
| Model Releases | GPT-5 Orion preview, Gemini 2.5 Pro Flash, Codestral 25.02 | More powerful coding and reasoning capabilities |
| Tooling | LangChain v0.4 rewrites APIs, vLLM boosts throughput, Ollama adds cloud/finetune | Easier dev workflows, better performance |
| Research | Anthropic CMA improves RAG | Better agent memory handling |
| Policy | EU AI Act enforcement starts | Compliance burden increases |

*(All information is dated to UTC week of Feb 17–23, 2025. Dates reflect publication dates, not necessarily availability timelines.)*
